'''Bandi''' was a [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He stood one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall and was skilled in dodging, hiding, sneaking, climbing, jumping, survival, and in the use of [[Bow/Legends|bows]] and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]]. He wore an animal [[Bone/Legends|skull]] as headgear and carried a [[Spear/Legends|spear]], a bow, a [[Flute/Legends|flute]], and [[Leather/Legends|leather]] pouches.<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bandi was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Bandi's character type was listed as just "Ewok" and his model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
